response.overview: The meaning of making - a treatise on making films, making music and the economic impact of the freelance creative life. A film director's journey to understand the point of the audience.  Filmed over two months this is the recording of "Feel Good", the first solo single from The Scene's frontman Andy Welsh - out now on Detour Records. Producer Pat Dooner and audio engineer Carl Conway-Davis, BBC 6 Music faves from The Broken Orchestra, welcome different players to a north England industrial studio. All was filmed and edited by Mal Williamson and the story is then narrated by this bitter and frustrated film-maker with plenty of moaning to do.
response.title: Make Me Feel Good
